title: File system keyboard nav splits selection, one duplicates the other renames
body: ### Tested versions Reproduced in: v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da] v4.6.2.rc1.official [257ac3532] v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory ### Issue description In the File system panel. Mouse click selecting a file, then arrow up or down selecting, splits the selection in two: - one bright selection on the last mouse clicked file - another low contrast selection where the arrow keys moved it Each of the split selections respond to different keyboard shortcuts: - the bright mouse clicked selection, duplicates with: `ctrl + d` - the low contrast arrow key selection, renames with: `F2` Expected The file system panel should behave like the scene panel, where the bright mouse clicked selection follows the arrow keys. This single selection, both duplicates and renames. ### Steps to reproduce - open the project: [file-system-kbd-nav-splits-selection.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26023008/file-system-kbd-nav-splits-selection.zip) - in the file system panel - mouse click select the first scene: `a.tscn` - move the mouse pointer to the Filter Files input box above the files, to keep the file system panel focused, and to prevent a mouse over tooltip from covering the selections - on a keyboard, press `arrow down` three times to select: `d.tscn` Issue 1 of 2: The first selection remains on the mouse clicked file: `a.tscn` A second low contrast selection moved to: `d.tscn` Expected 1 or 2: The initial selection should move with the arrow keys, this already happens in the scene panel. (see second video below) Continue reproduction steps: With the two selections: - press `ctrl + d` to duplicate Issue 2 of 2: The Duplicate file dialog opens with the mouse selected file: `a.tscn` Expected 2 of 2: The last file that was interacted with: `d.tscn` should be duplicated. This happens when pressing `F2`. It starts renaming the arrow key selected file: `d.tscn` Screen recordings: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da05c57e-a1c8-4de2-b98c-583f13fc83f6 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41daa950-fc22-4ca3-a98d-d3485e1b6dee ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [file-system-kbd-nav-splits-selection.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26023008/file-system-kbd-nav-splits-selection.zip)
